is_anopheles.evidence: The study includes Anopheles gambiae s.l. as a primary vector of interest.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports only phenotypic bioassay results (knockdown and mortality rates). It does not genotype any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data is reported; the study is purely phenotypic.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Osogbo, Nigeria.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Osogbo metropolis, Osun State, Nigeria.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between May and September 2022.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study appears to be a routine new collection.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is needed as the paper is a bioassay-only study.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the insecticide susceptibility of field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l., Culex quinquefasciatus, and Aedes aegypti in Osogbo, Nigeria, using WHO bioassays. It reports knockdown and mortality rates but does not perform any molecular genotyping of resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: No molecular markers were genotyped.
